units.source_text: 他的梦里出现了等待绞刑的维龙的形象。

en.t: In his dreams appeared the figure of Villon awaiting the gallows.

units.source_text: 数次他险些像维龙那样堕入人生的底层。

en.t: Several times he nearly sank, like Villon, to the lowest depths of life.

units.source_text: 可是他的境遇和身体不允许这样做。

en.t: But his circumstances and his body would not allow him to do so.

units.source_text: 他日渐衰弱，就像从前斯威夫特见到过的从树梢开始逐渐枯萎树木一样……

en.t: He grew weaker day by day, like the trees Swift had once seen gradually withering from their topmost branches...
